items.title: Paul Barnes Interview, 1971-03-13
items.q: She got married to Norvin Kimball.

ctx.x: She stayed with Ridgely. So we had to get a piano player and in those times lady piano players were very popular with bands in those days. So we went across the lake and we met, I got a girl over there, Jeanette Sullivan, her name is. She got married to Norvin Kimball.
